title: ಬಸವಣ್ಣನವರ ವಚನಗಳು
author: ಬಸವಣ್ಣ
description: ಕಲ್ಯಾಣದ ಶರಣ ಚಳವಳಿಯ ನೇತಾರ ಬಸವಣ್ಣನವರ ೧೩೨ ಆಯ್ದ ವಚನಗಳು — ನಡೆ-ನುಡಿ, ಕುಲಸಮಾನತೆ, ಡಾಂಭಿಕತೆಯ ವಿಡಂಬನೆ, ಶರಣ-ಜಂಗಮ ಭಕ್ತಿ. ಅಂಕಿತ: ಕೂಡಲಸಂಗಮದೇವ.

provenance.licenseNote: Basavanna (ಬಸವಣ್ಣ) died 1196 CE; text is public domain worldwide. Taken from the Kannada Wikisource edition: the author index page above links one page per vachana; the exact pages used are listed in sources.txt beside this file. Only the vachana text was taken (modern remarks on the pages were dropped); line breaks re-flowed at sentence ends where the import had split lines at commas.
provenance.author: ಬಸವಣ್ಣ
